name: New Hope: Christmas Special
source:
The New Hope Christmas Special is full of fun and naughty content. Ethan sings a super catchy song, the group play a drunk game of Truth or Dare... AND we end with an explosive climax.

[From [url=https://apollostudios-lgbt.itch.io/new-hope-christmas-special]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《New Hope》聖誕特別篇裡，歡樂和出格的橋段一樣不少。伊桑會唱一首特別洗腦的歌，大夥兒醉醺醺地玩起真心話大冒險……最後，再以一場勁爆的高潮收尾。
